decision.matchup: Oklahoma City Thunder vs Denver Nuggets
decision.reason: Projected Oklahoma City Thunder 118–114 Denver Nuggets. Fair line Oklahoma City Thunder -3.5, Oklahoma City Thunder -164. DraftKings implies 74% vs model 62% (-12.0%). Too far from the market this early; the price likely knows something the ratings do not. Oklahoma City Thunder lost Isaiah Joe; Oklahoma City Thunder lineup +4.0 pts vs their rated games; Denver Nuggets adds DeMar DeRozan (18.4 ppg), Marvin Bagley III (10.4 ppg) not yet in their results; Denver Nuggets lost Jonas Valanciunas, Peyton Watson, Tim Hardaway Jr.; Denver Nuggets lineup +5.5 pts vs their rated games; Key matchup Shai Gilgeous-Alexander 31.2/4.3/6.5 vs Nikola Jokic 27.7/12.9/10.7 (pts/reb/ast); Oklahoma City Thunder 3-1 vs Denver Nuggets this season and last (avg -0.2).

report.conclusion: Promising retrospective signal, not sufficient proof: only 2 evaluated seasons and 6 weekly blocks, without prospective calibration evidence.
limitations: Retrospective source vintages; original historical pregame receipts unverified.
Only two evaluation seasons and a small number of seven-day blocks; long-range team dependence is not removed.
No roster, trade, lineup or injury adjustments; previous-season observations may describe a changed team.
Winner-rule gates are compared as availability only; the production weighted engine cannot be exactly reconstructed without historical point-in-time standings.
Ending-2026 outcomes excluded from this study, but previously used by older project scoring research; not a globally untouched holdout.
All post-freeze future games are reserved for genuinely prospective validation; no automatic production promotion.

protocol.calibration: Expanding earlier early-season games only; minimum 50; no regression fitting
protocol.early_sample_definition: Either team has fewer than six prior eligible same-season regular games
protocol.nba_holdout_note: Ending 2026 excluded from this experiment, but already used by earlier project scoring research; not globally untouched
protocol.probability: Normal margin residual CDF; bias, spread and absolute-error intervals calibrated on earlier seasons only
protocol.production_promotion: Forbidden in this experiment; research disabled by default; prospective collection required
protocol.prospective_holdout: All games after protocol timestamp; no outcomes used until a later authorized evaluation
protocol.score_formula: Existing _calibrate_nba_projections with explicitly blended scoring/conceding stats, no form double-count, injuries/standings/odds omitted, home advantage only when not neutral
